_comment: Copy to gmh15_right.json and edit. ranges_deg keys are command indices (0 idx MCP, 2 mid MCP, 4 ring MCP, 6 little MCP, 8 thumb CMC, 9 thumb MCP, 10 thumb IP). Defaults = angles already commanded on the real right hand without faults. pinch_pose_deg must be MEASURED on the real hand (jog thumb+index tips into contact in the teleop UI, read joints_degrees); leave null until then.
